correctness.rationale: Every orbit of the partial S_k action is indexed by its first-block weight and free suffix; maximal internal Hamming distance is 2min(w,k-w), leaving four families. Direct maximum-distance inequalities yield the complete orbit-compatibility flag graph. Dominating all weight-one and co-weight-one orbit vertices reduces two principal pieces to X_f. At k=4 exactly 2^(f+1) triangle-free bridging edges remain, giving 2^(f+1)-1 circle summands; for k>=5 no bridges remain. Verified all ranges including f=1 and k=4 boundaries. The independent finite algorithmic checks are supplementary.

value.rationale: The exact geometric fixed-locus homotopy type exhibits a sharp four-versus-five-coordinate transition: connected spaces with exponentially many first-homology generators versus two disconnected lower-dimensional complexes. The same theorem covers every free suffix dimension and yields mixed H1/H7 at f=4. These features cannot be read from ambient Betti numbers and are meaningful to equivariant topology and Rips complexes.
